Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Healing From the Mind Outward", "body": "Kalina says every physical symptom stems from the mental and emotional body, and recalls a teacher who studied with Inca elders and framed healing as working one level above where a problem shows up. Chance adds that an injury only improved once he addressed his energy body through chi gong, and the talk touches on Eileen McKusick's bio field maps. Chance also talks about finding the leaks where a person sheds energy so they can hold more power, while Kalina adds that remedies on the third dimension only last after the inner work is done. Both frame this as personal experience and philosophy."}, {"title": "Fear as the Doorway to Sovereignty", "body": "Kalina describes her deepest fears rising to look her in the eyes like a snake, and says facing them returned what she calls her true power, not the woo-woo love and light kind. She traces her research habit to joining the Air Force at 17 and reading a book before September 11th that she says described the attack, which set her on the conspiracy path in 2001. Chance echoes the theme, asking how anything can be added to a source that is already everything, so there is nothing to fear."}, {"title": "Synchronicity and Doing Your Part", "body": "Chance describes sensing that a planned recording would not happen, then learning days later that his friend's internet had been cut, and he offers it as one of many examples of events showing up on the psychic plane before they reach 3D. He also says a collaborator reached out and a project came together the next day, and his advice is to do the part you can do now and trust the next piece to arrive, probably better than if forced. Kalina agrees, framing the same instinct as her intention for the conversation, believing every person carries medicine to offer the collective."}, {"title": "Templis Aquaria and the Land That Called", "body": "Kalina says she asked the universe for a farm in the mountains with a waterfall and then stumbled on a real estate video of the exact property, which she closed on after meditating there. She plans the retreat center Templis Aquaria with private waterfalls, no 5G, and a church structure she describes as a health and truth platform that puts people in direct contact with source. Chance calls the idea of legal protection through a religious organization the most positive use of religion he has heard of."}, {"title": "Crypto, Nodes and Decentralized Freedom", "body": "Kalina says she went from rejecting crypto to being obsessed with it, and describes the old pyramid power structure giving way to a web of equal nodes that she and the audience can become. She argues decentralized currency cannot be controlled or regulated and may help people escape debt, while predicting most people will be herded into regulated digital currency. Chance says he has not jumped in yet but agrees that real decentralization would end the old paradigm."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Kalina Lux is a benevolent biohacktress with a mission to heal the planetary fractal by helping humans heal their bodies. In this conversation we discuss her mission to manifest Templīs Aquária, a healing retreat center in Puerto Rico. Tangential topics include 5G and detoxing environment toxicity, physical and energetic alike, and our potential to alchemically transmute anything within ourselves into a harmonious expression. All of this is framed around how we can embody our sovereign nature within the evolving techno-cratic Babylon.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension, Kalina speaks about why she's on the cryptocurrency train, we discuss decentralization as a keystone to a free future, and continue expanding on many topics initiated in the first hour.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Kalina's Claims About Shielding Foods", "body": "Kalina says okra, turmeric, coconut water and fresh fruit juice help the body build what she calls exclusion zone water, which she credits with buffering the field against non-native electromagnetic exposure for hours at a time. She attributes the idea to Gerald Pollack's work on structured water, and Chance links it to Eileen McKusick's description of the bio field as bioplasma with a protective sheath. These are their stated beliefs and reading, offered as simple everyday hacks, not established medical advice."}, {"title": "Numerology of 5G and 5D", "body": "The talk turns to a playful numerology puzzle about why people feared 5G while also talking about 5D ascension. One speaker points out that D is the fourth letter and G the seventh, and that adding one through four reaches ten, as does reducing the seven pattern, so each can echo wholeness. The reading offered is that one path leads toward a seven color prism of the human and the other toward the four directions of nature, and the other speaker says it blew their mind."}, {"title": "A Beginner's Road Into Crypto", "body": "Kalina says she is a complete beginner, calls the learning curve like entering a foreign world, and believes it is made hard on purpose for Americans. She describes saving ten dollars at a time, joining a trading course and reporting early gains, while refusing any coin she believes will be used for tracking. Chance replies that new currencies deserve as much scrutiny as the dollar, and that paying for a course creates an energetic commitment. Their returns and predictions are personal claims, not advice."}, {"title": "Banks, Rivers and the Judge's Bench", "body": "Chance weaves word origins into the conversation, saying the bench a judge sits on is called a bank, so moving value from liquid riverbank systems into an airy, digital element also sidesteps that judge. Kalina says liquidity was the old currency of the last epoch, and that an air-based coin like Ethereum fits the new one. Kalina adds that leaving the dollar also means leaving the contracts attached to it, a legal claim she offers as her own understanding."}, {"title": "Coherence, Memory and What Comes Next", "body": "Chance floats an idea that memory lives in the electromagnetic field, so someone who leaves their body with a coherent field might keep it and choose where to go, taking loved ones along. Kalina answers that Tibetan monks hold a similar belief about dying in coherence. She then describes retiring from constant conspiracy research after moving to the jungle, tending a garden with cats and chickens, and feeling her spark for life return, while Chance praises her glow."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "We have to be more confident that we're doing the right things for our bodies and trust in the power of our bodies because we've cared for them.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I will not quantumly entangle my energy with anything that doesn't serve where I'm going.
